ev-questions.intro.say: This lets you write your own questions to add to a pack, so a run answers them from your code too.

ev-questions.action.ask: What would you like to do?

options.label: Write a new question set
options.description: Starts a new set of your own questions.

options.label: Change a question set
options.description: Pick a saved question set to change.

options.label: Delete a question set
options.description: Pick a saved question set to delete.

ev-questions.which-change.ask: Which set would you like to change?

ev-questions.delete-both.say: Deletes it from this machine and your account.

ev-questions.not-deleted.say: Your account couldn't be reached, so <name> wasn't deleted. Run /ev-questions again later.

ev-questions.listed-unreachable.say: Your account couldn't be reached, so only sets on this machine are shown.

ev-questions.listed-none.say: You have no saved question sets yet.

ev-questions.listed-no-pack.say: <name>, <where>, needs a pack before a run can use it.

ev-questions.where-both.say: on this machine and your account

ev-questions.listed-refused.say: <name> on your account needs fixing. Choose it to fix it.

ev-questions.off-account.say: The question set <set> is no longer on your account.

ev-questions.set-not-kept.say: Your account couldn't be reached, so <set> is only on this machine. Run /ev-questions later to add it to your account.

ev-questions.first-set.say: You have no saved question sets yet, so let's write your first one.

ev-questions.fix-said.say: <name> needs fixing before a run can use it. I'll fix it and show you the result.

ev-questions.which-pack.ask: Which pack should these questions extend?

ev-questions.pack-about.say: Your questions cost nothing extra, and print after the pack's own.

ev-questions.keeps-clauses.say: <pack> keeps its publisher's clauses, so your questions can extend one of your Evalation packs instead.

ev-questions.packs-unreachable.ask: Evalation couldn't be reached, so the packs can't be shown. Try again?

ev-questions.source.ask: Where should the questions come from?

options.label: Questions I type
options.description: You write your own questions next.

options.label: Features a website claims
options.description: Checks a web page's feature claims against the code.

options.label: Features a document claims
options.description: Checks a pitch deck's or product sheet's feature claims against the code.

ev-questions.document.say: Drag the file into this window, or type its full path, such as ~/Downloads/pitch.pdf.

ev-questions.claims.ask: Which of these claims should become questions?

ev-questions.type.say: Type your questions in your next message, one sentence for each.

ev-questions.name.ask: What should this question set be called?

ev-questions.name-about.say: Saves the set under this name.

ev-questions.name-taken.say: A saved set already has that name.

ev-questions.checking.say: Checking your questions. This can take a few minutes.

ev-questions.left-out.say: I left out your question <title>, since it <why>.

ev-questions.kept-organisation.say: <question> is now an organisation question, since only your own records can answer it.

ev-questions.kept-organisation-added.say: <question> is now an organisation question, since only your own records can answer it. I added <added> to cover what the code does about it.

ev-questions.save-unchecked.ask: The independent checker couldn't confirm <titles>. Save them unchecked, or change something?

options.label: Save them unchecked
options.description: Saves the set as shown, marked as not confirmed.

ev-questions.save-unchecked-one.ask: The independent checker couldn't confirm <titles>. Save it unchecked, or change something?

options.label: Save it unchecked
options.description: Saves the set as shown, marked as not confirmed.

ev-questions.keep-on-account.ask: Also keep this set on your account?

options.label: Keep it on my account
options.description: You can use it on your other computers too.

options.label: Keep it on this machine only

ev-questions.next-run.say: Next time you run /ev-run with <pack>, you can tick <name>.

ev-questions.unconfirmed-note.say: Runs and reports treat unconfirmed questions like any others.
